cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though. Can you catch a later train?
